wikitext:
===Stub===
The word '''stub''' means something that is very short. On Wikimedia sites, a stub is a short article. When writers begin a new article, they use the stub template banner to show that people can add a lot more useful information. 

To do this, insert the following text into the first line of the article:

 <nowiki>{{stub}}</nowiki>

This will display as:

{{stub}}

If you make or find a stub, you can improve the article yourself in accordance with our [[Project:Guidelines|guidelines]] or add the task to our community [[Project:To-do list|to-do list]].
To find a stub, use the following links:

*[[Special:Whatlinkshere/Template:Stub]]
*[[Special:Shortpages]] (sometimes, the article has not been marked a stub)

===Empty sections===
Empty sections of pages should contain the following:

 <nowiki>{{empty}}</nowiki>

This will display as:
{{empty}}

===No References===
Pages that do not feature citations should implement the following code in the references section:

 <nowiki>{{references}}</nowiki>

This will display as:
{{references}}

==See also==
*[[Responsible use]]
*[[PsychonautWiki]]
